verdict_text: NO. The sharding function does not force `gpt_neox.embed_in.weight` and `embed_out.weight` into individual shards; because each is about 206 MB—below the 512 MiB threshold—they may be packed with other tensors. This violates the explicit requirement that each of those tensors be stored alone.
